Hello gentlemen! A new development log is here. Let's take a look at what else is in "Days with girlfriends: Kello&Cammy)"!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3172190/_/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3169810/_/
[h3]Gentleman Q: How did the story of [Contract Girlfriend] begin! ?
Cat A: Well... it all started on a rainy night... but...😶 (squinting)[/h3]
[Golwa Town] is famous for its delicious sweet wine🍶 and was once selected as the most suitable town for living.
It is surrounded by mountains and rivers, and the folk customs are simple and romantic.
You just graduated and left home for the first time, so you came here,
and unexpectedly found a good job, tasting various flavors of sweet wine🍷
and various kinds of food🍱 every day, and lived a stable life for a while.
One rainy night, I walked into an ordinary tavern to avoid the rain, breaking my peaceful life.

[b]📑[Contract Girlfriend Signing Sheet]📑: In order to satisfy the man's personal emotional and physical needs for a specific period of time, the two parties have decided to sign this contract on the principle of equality and voluntariness. The woman will fulfill her role as “contract girlfriend” and provide the man with the necessary physical companionship and emotional support.
(Man): __________; (Woman): __________.[/b]
That's right, renting a girlfriend for a day is one of the special flavors of Golva, a town where, late at night, the once romantic atmosphere turns into the complete opposite of a catharsis of desire!

[h3]Gentleman Q: Kello, who appeared in the past, is also a candidate for contract girlfriend?
Maomao A: There is a story behind this, very close in a certain way![/h3]

💝After Kello 's father remarried your mother, she became your half-sister.
The two of you had an ambiguous time, you loved her beauty and body, but hated the many suitors she attracted, which led to a gap between you, and eventually your relationship drifted apart due to personality twists and misunderstandings, and then you broke off your relationship and both left your hometown...By coincidence, you are reunited in a strange town, in a strange tavern, and she becomes one of the candidates for a contract girlfriend.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/37430609/719fa2bdb86913126c999b80b7ddb749602ee4e2.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Kello
[*] Occupation: Governess
[*] Age: 26
[*] Circumference: 94(H)-61-89
[*] Height: about 1.65 meters
[*] Body type: well-built, slightly slender
[/list]
Dyed waist-length purple azalea hair, with always naturally falling, hair quality as echoing the temperament of the smooth; purple gemstone wave light eyes, so that her gaze rendered gentle but deep attract people fascinated, from time to time to exude elegance and gentleness, to give people a feeling that can be relied on.
For some reason, she is always fond of purple color clothes, often wearing some simple suits or dresses, revealing a kind of mature female charm.
Her purple eyes were filled with suppressed interest in you, but for some reason she was deterred.

Gentleman Q: I heard that there is another candidate for contract girlfriend...? What's her name...?
Maomao A: You were saying just now that you couldn’t control yourself when you saw her fishnet stockings and big white legs...? (Maomao is speechless)
💝Cammy is a DJ at a well-known local bar, and every night she stands on the bar's stage and dances with abandon, and you occasionally visit her bar to relax.
Interestingly, you, a guest who drinks alone but always refuses to be approached by others, have attracted Cammy's attention.
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/37430609/bb409ae79f166e2fa2be31b862dc45cac367b13d.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Cammy
[*] Occupation: bar DJ
[*] Age: 25
[*] Measurements: 97 (G)-62-95
[*] Height: about 1.69 meters
[*] Body shape: tall and well-proportioned, curvy
[/list]
Cammy has short silver-white hair with a sharp cut, flaming red pupils that can easily seduce a man's charisma, teasing and playful eyes, and an occasional glint of loneliness and coldness, as if hiding an untold story, of which you're about to become a part.
She often wears tulle tops, shorts and fishnet stockings.
You're a mystery to her, something she wants to explore, the man who savors his wine alone, who takes some interest in you, but doesn't expect you to patronize the bar again.

[h3]💝Conclusion[/h3]
No one knows that you and Kello are brother and sister... There was even a secret that was not known to everyone... Here you can indulge as much as you want and even fall in love?! I wonder if you can break the traditional thinking with your sister (pseudo-orthopedics) Come together! ?
What?!! You said you still can’t resist Cammy’s fishnet stockings and big white legs…? Want them all?!! (Maomao is speechless)
You have to remember the rules. No matter what, you must choose the one you are most satisfied with and sign the final contract with your girlfriend after experiencing the one-day contract.

[h3]💝Thanks[/h3]
This log ends here. If you have some ideas, you are welcome to communicate with us!!!
Work with us to make the next project better! Sincerely thank you for your support and expectations!

notes.title: "Fairy Biography 6: Revenge" will be launched on Steam on August 9, 2024!
notes.content:
[b]Fairy Biography 6: Revenge will be launched on Steam on August 9, 2024. [/b]

This game uses a relaxing and puzzle-solving find-the-difference game as a medium to tell you a fantasy story - about the struggle for power between different races on this continent, the baptism of blood and the abyss of desire.
There are also new characters to bring you a brand new experience!

If you are interested, you may click on the store page below to quickly purchase and play!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2937990/Fairy_Biography_6__Revenge/

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/f73ffab99bb5259cb6ac2a93d13862b4f7f476c5.png[/img]

This story takes place on a fantasy continent where various races live.
Humans, werewolves, vampires, succubi... they were not willing to live in peace in a corner, so the war started, the smoke filled the air, and the flames of the power struggle burned on the earth.

In the end, the vampire king won, but he was on the throne, but he spent his days drinking and partying.

The seeds of crisis quietly sprouted, and this continent is about to usher in an unprecedented disaster.
But perhaps, this will be an opportunity to reshuffle the cards between races; perhaps, the continent will enter a new era because of this.

And what did the people on this continent do and what price did they pay for this struggle for power and honor?

The outcome is uncertain, and everything is a variable.
All of this will be witnessed by you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/7a9931643e4c0c618eead4a1df187a2e25549ce6.png[/img]

This is a puzzle game of finding differences.
In the game, you need to find all the differences between two pictures related to the story by comparing them.
Each level has 3 differences. When all the differences are successfully circled, the next level will be unlocked. After unlocking all levels, you can get the whole beautiful CG and gradually explore the true story of the whole game.

Which race will win in the end, and what kind of adventures will they have in the story?
This is an extreme test of the player's observation and concentration. Try to experience the complete story through all levels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/8228bed586e320117efebce6178705c6398d3a4e.png[/img]

[*] Original world view and story of the imaginary continent
[*] Different characters of different races
[*] A large number of rich and beautiful CGs
[*] Interesting and casual games, simple and enjoyable
